notes: Testnet only. Simulated money: all mock USDC amounts are Simulated. Public keys only; no private keys or seed phrases.

Steps 17a to 17m of DEPLOY_PLAN were run on 2026-11-14 UTC, each chain write after its own owner yes. Step 17e (the OutLayer secret access rule) was set by the owner in the OutLayer dashboard with a wallet; no transaction id is recorded by this project. It was read back from outlayer.testnet (secrets_exist true) and the rule is: Logic And[WasmHash(c4a29e55...), Predecessor Whitelist[auction.royltee-dev.testnet]]; storage deposit 0.00692 NEAR. Steps 17l (recovery calls) and 17n (delete the auction key) were NOT run: 17l was not needed, 17n is not run by decision (the key stays, review B).

17b ends in a failure on purpose: the FastFS upload is a 1 Tgas call to outlayer.testnet __fastdata_fastfs, signed by the auction account, which has no such method. The failure is MethodNotFound on the receiver; FastFS reads the transaction data and serves the module anyway (sha256 c4a29e55ca61da2e069bdcfebd4d4e6690820620582ed2635d1dd6bc17c2594e).
17i ended the auction 20 minutes after sending (ends_at 1794652730000000000, 2026-11-14T10:38:50Z) instead of the 10 minutes in the plan, so that both bids fit.
17k: the transaction landed in block 277645673 at 10:39:05Z; the OutLayer execution happened later, at 10:41:00Z by the verifier's record, and its callback finished the sale.

When this file was written, the registry record in deployments/testnet.json on the auction branch was the audit F1 snapshot. The registry on chain was redeployed afterwards (final contract fixes, 52jp95BV..., code hash 5YNk7mvmiq4SuSckR1gULXVvgcRdUjaioxmDE8niguAG). After the branches were merged, deployments/testnet.json holds the up to date registry record, and npm run verify:testnet checks both records.
Read only checks were made with RPC view calls on 2026-11-14 at about 11:05 to 11:30 UTC (block heights 277648160 to 277649644).
